name: Hanns Seidel Foundation: PhD scholarships
summary: The Hanns Seidel Foundation, which is affiliated with the Christian Social Union (CSU), provides funding for doctoral projects and research stays for international doctoral candidates. Applicants from all disciplines completing promising
